# Vendored: TinyMCP

`external/TinyMCP` and `gamepad-mcp-server/external` are identical copies of
https://github.com/sparesparrow/TinyMCP at commit
`2bd0fabc74a41383cd8b075b8eb1abf2fdc73060`, with local modifications to
`CMakeLists.txt` and `Source/Protocol/Public/Config.cpp`.

Their nested `.git` directories were removed so the files are tracked directly.
